assets.name: Ild Tenger
assets.source_note: Meshy text-to-3D preview -> refine (meshy-7.1, 4K, PBR). Real textured GLB downloaded (28.6MB, 30147 tris, baseColor+metalRough+normal) and rendered in Blender headless (assets/previews/suld_ild_tenger_hero.png). NOTE: vanilla Minecraft Java item models are box-only, so the in-game model (resourcepack/.../suld_ild_tenger.json) is a Blockbench low-poly box model guided by the Meshy silhouette+textures; the Meshy mesh itself is the promo/NPC/reference asset, not a native Java item mesh.
assets.lore_mn: Тэнгэрийн илд — хойд зүгийн тэнгэрийн дор давтагдсан домогт ир.
assets.lore_en: A blade forged under the eternal sky; its edge remembers the horizon.
